title: NPE when using objc_library+cc_library as deps for cc_test

labels.name: P0
labels.description: This is an emergency and more important than other current work. (Assignee required)

body:
### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

When using this build file:
```python
cc_library(
    name = "a",
    srcs = ["NONEXISTANT.c"],
)

objc_library(
    name = "b",
    deps = [
        ":a",
    ],
)

cc_test(
    name = "d",
    deps = [":b"],
)
```

And running:
```
$ bazel build //:d
```
